scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release --offline -p sieve_core && wasm-bindgen target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/sieve_core.wasm --out-dir crates/sieve_core/pkg --target web
scripts.test: npm run build:wasm && npm run test:rs && node --test tests/wasm/*.test.ts tests/unit/*.test.ts
